verdict.rationale: Gaudi 3 ships a software stack (Docker images, PyTorch integration, vLLM serving), so whether that stack collects telemetry and lets users opt out is a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
